flags.message: CourtListener MCP was unusable for this cell: the first search call returned HTTP 429 (shared 1400/day limit exhausted, ~100-minute retry window), so the cell degraded to provisioned inputs, the committed statpack, and web search per the retrieval contract. Late cells in a large fan-out will predictably hit this; a per-cell call budget or a workflow-level backoff would keep them from running without live CourtListener access.
